articles.summary: Kodiak is working with NVIDIA to integrate the DRIVE Hyperion architecture into the next generation of the Kodiak Driver, combining advanced AI software with powerful centralized computing to support the scaling of driverless vehicles.
articles.title: Kodiak AI Scales Autonomous Driving with NVIDIA DRIVE Hyperion

articles.summary: Kodiak, Epirus, and GDLS introduce an autonomous counter-UAS vehicle combining AI-driven mobility with a high-power microwave system to defeat drone threats.
articles.title: Epirus, General Dynamics Land Systems and Kodiak AI Unveil New Autonomous HPM System for Counter-UAS
